Class H3Cell

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3Cell
@Entity public class H3Cell extends Object
JPA Entity representing an H3 Level 8 hexagon cell (~1 km² area). Stores terrain and climate data for a single hexagonal cell on Earth.

This entity is designed for GPU-parallel processing: each cell can be updated independently on the GPU using TornadoVM.

2.0.0

    • calculateMovementFriction

      public double calculateMovementFriction(double techLevel)
      Calculates terrain movement friction (cost-distance factor) based on elevation, biome, water resources and current technology level.
      Parameters:
      techLevel - technology level (1.0 = ancient, 10.0 = modern)
      Returns:
      movement friction multiplier (1.0 = baseline flat plain, >10.0 = extreme mountain/desert/swamp)

    • getEffectiveSurfaceAreaKm2

      public double getEffectiveSurfaceAreaKm2()
      Calculates the effective 3D real surface area of the cell in km², taking into account: 1. Spherical projection latitude distortion (Equal-Area H3 base planimetric projection). 2. Topographical 3D slope expansion derived from terrain ruggedness / movement friction.
      Returns:
      Effective 3D surface area in km² (>= 0.737 km² base).
